learning_objective: 🎯 To understand the science of hot and cold, and learn how to accurately measure heat using a trusty thermometer!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We can feel if a cup of milk is hot or an ice cream is cold. Temperature is the exact scientific measurement that tells us exactly how hot or how cold an object really is!
We cannot always trust our touch to guess temperature, as it can trick us! Scientists use a special tool called a thermometer to get an accurate reading in degrees.
When you have a fever, the doctor uses a clinical thermometer to check your body. It has a tiny shining liquid inside that climbs up the scale when it gets warm!

fun_activity.title: 🌡️ Hot, Cold, and Normal Trick
fun_activity.instructions: Take three bowls: one with warm water, one with ice water, and one with normal tap water. Dip your left hand in warm and right in cold for a minute, then put both in normal water. It will feel cool and warm at the same time!

quick_recap: ⭐ Temperature is a reliable measure of the hotness or coldness of an object.
⭐ A thermometer is the device used to measure temperature accurately.
⭐ Clinical thermometers are specially designed to measure the temperature of the human body safely.
